reviews.title: Works as Advertised. Prices continue to Drop. Works great in my PS5
reviews.comment: Works great installed in my ps5. Prices continue to drop on these so you can now pick up a 2TB for around what I paid for 1TB. Easy install. Includes required heat sink. Have been using for a few years with no issues. Data transfers are very fast between the preinstalled internal drive and this 2nd internal drive. No complaints.

reviews.title: Flawless Performance Upgrade for PS5: WD_BLACK SN850 with Heatsink
reviews.comment: This WD_BLACK 1TB SN850 NVMe SSD has transformed my PlayStation 5 gaming experience! The installation was a breeze, thanks to its M.2 2280 form factor and compatibility with the PS5. The heatsink not only keeps temperatures in check but also adds a sleek touch to my console's internals. With blazing-fast speeds of up to 7,000 MB/s, loading times are a thing of the past, giving me a competitive edge in every game. If you're looking for a reliable SSD upgrade with style and performance, look no further than the WD_BLACK series. It's a flawless victory for me!

reviews.title: Best SSD for PS5
reviews.comment: Bought this to upgrade the storage on my PS5. Installation was easy and the system had no issues reading the drive and formatting it. You get the full capacity advertised on the drive for storage, no space is reserved for system usage or anything. The drive speed is phenomenal and well beyond the recommended specs set by Sony. Easily the best SSD on the market right now and is a must purchase for any PS5 user. ***Just a little heads up, I had trouble removing the screw inside the SSD expansion bay. The screw is very flimsy and threads easily and the issue appears wide spread online. So take extra care while installing your SSD and make sure to use the right tools***

reviews.title: One of the best NVMe drive for the PS5
reviews.comment: The PlayStation 5 comes with less than a terabyte of storage space. That's hardly enough for you to keep all your favorite games, let alone record video clips, take screenshots, and save other data. The good news is upgrading your PS5 storage has never been easier, thanks to the secondary M.2 SSD slot that lets you add a second SSD, similar to adding storage to your gaming PC. The WD_Black SN850 is a bit more expensive than other drive on Amazon, but still offers tremendous value, thanks to its a faster 7,300MB/s sequential read speed. The 6,300MB/s write speed isn't as fast, but you should be able to save games quickly like you can with most other options. If you’re concerned about heat dissipation, this drive comes with a heat-sink to maintain safe operating temperatures, even under a heavy load. And it’s guaranteed to fit snugly in the small quarters of the PS5’s M2 slot. Plus, it comes with a 5-year or 600 TBW warranty, so this SSD is a great investment that (hopefully should) last you the console's lifetime.
